title: 'McDreamy!' Grey's Anatomy star takes selfies with U of T students | The Moment
summary: Becca Liski tells The National about the moment she ran out of her University of Toronto classroom to meet Patrick Dempsey, best known for playing Dr. Derek 'McDreamy' Shepherd on Grey's Anatomy.
